scope.purpose: Exercise H2 PostgreSQL schema/authentication and initial activation SQL boundary with real isolated PostgreSQL and retained G1-G5 regression. This is not full Temporal H2 acceptance.
scope.acceptance_limit: No Temporal service, dispatcher/projector process, RPC-start crash cut, workflow history/restart, H1 H2 acceptance, or original AT execution is covered by this schema subgate. Original AT-05/16/29 remain unexecuted. H1 five-case actual service suite remains a required separate/final integrated check.

purpose: Pin exact regression and new H2 schema-phase tests before any test/service execution. Preserve original 351 Python IDs from accepted G6 evidence and add nine independently named PostgreSQL schema/SQL protocol cases.
target: PostgreSQL migrations 001/002 historical compatibility and migration 003 schema/backfill/role registry
Dispatcher/projector function ACL, deployment/build/principal registration and SQL activation protocol
method: Run four sequential PostgreSQL-backed pytest phases with isolated temporary real PostgreSQL clusters. New H2 tests use workflow_schema_db or explicit legacy migration setup and independent literal schema/hash/transition oracles. Existing G1/G2/G3/G4/G5 case IDs are copied from the accepted G6 archive api/gate.json and must remain exact. H2 per-case setup/body+cleanup timing evidence and private SQL cause-chain diagnostics are emitted only inside the gate's private evidence directory.
agent: TC owns independent fixtures, schema/SQL assertions, and this ledger. Main owns migration/runtime SQL and bounded runner. Independent reviewers validate the exact frozen candidate. No service or test execution has yet been authorized by this ledger.
pass_criteria: All 351 prior case IDs match the accepted G6 archive exactly and pass with no failures/errors/skips.
All nine H2 schema test IDs pass against real PostgreSQL; every case is within the reviewed 30-second limit and has a timing record.
Migration 001/002 bytes and hashes remain unchanged; role SCRAM rules and database lifecycle are restored/stopped by the reviewed runner.

The actual G4 accepted create DTO survives H2 reserve, run fencing and activation; exact internal receipt replay remains idempotent after revocation, while stale claims/generations do not mutate state.
Private diagnostic records, if expected MIGRATION_IO failures occur, retain only test-private SQL exception-chain evidence at mode 0600 and never publish it as a client-facing error.

new_case_groups.target: 001/002→003 upgrade and malformed historical create-origin rows
new_case_groups.method: Real isolated PostgreSQL; compare preserved rows/hash ledger and assert full rollback for missing/ambiguous origin.
new_case_groups.pass_criteria: Valid history backfills only the unique create command; invalid history leaves 003 absent and the prior schema/rows/ledger unchanged.
new_case_groups.expected: 003 records the explicit create-command relation without altering original 001/002 bytes or permitting arbitrary command joins.
evidence: 0600 private migration-cause record when gate enables diagnostics
Uncaught MigrationError cause chains are captured by the H2 pytest hook when the gate provides the private diagnostics path.

The SQL case explicitly asserts accepted lone-surrogate/astral/quote/backslash text is transported in the canonical ASCII G4 command, while a separate NUL request is rejected before command/job rows are created.
new_case_groups.failure_recovery: Retain private PostgreSQL lifecycle and SQL cause evidence; fix migration and rerun affected schema phase only after review.

new_case_groups.purpose: Role identity, privilege and deployment registry
new_case_groups.target: Four role OIDs/names, function ACL, deployment/build/worker-principal registration
new_case_groups.method: Inspect fixed expected signatures/privileges, use real SCRAM logins and wrong or absent credentials; recreate a role OID and attempt membership/name drift. The SCRAM fixture also opens a new correct-password dispatcher connection and confirms an absent-password connection fails immediately after HBA reload and before yielding to the test.
new_case_groups.pass_criteria: Only the intended role can execute each security-definer function; invalid identity/membership/OID drift is rejected atomically; trust-local fallback cannot authenticate service roles.
new_case_groups.expected: Role scopes and owner-registered immutable deployment/build identity match the approved H2 contract.
new_case_groups.failure_recovery: Restore isolated HBA/roles through fixture teardown; preserve failed private logs and recreate the temporary cluster.

new_case_groups.purpose: Initial activation SQL and receipt/run fences
new_case_groups.target: G4 create receipt, workspace readiness, dispatcher reserve/start/admit/delivery, projector activation and receipt replay
new_case_groups.method: Create through the actual G4 HTTP service, seed only required owner fixtures, connect with separate SCRAM dispatcher/projector principals, and call the versioned SQL API with literal wrong-token/generation/run cases. It also changes the workspace generation after reserve/admission for one pending accepted job and verifies quarantine/no activation, while a separate already-committed receipt still replays after a later workspace-generation change. Independently rebuild the exact 18 immutable binding fields and versioned SHA-256, then exercise real HTTP list/detail/command DTOs and idempotent POST replay before and after inserting a profile-less future human command and revoking current membership.
new_case_groups.pass_criteria: Valid DTO reserves and binds one execution; stale claim/run/workspace fences cannot apply; DRAFT revision 0 becomes QUEUED revision 1 exactly once; exact already-committed scoped projector receipt replays unchanged after mutable user authority is revoked. The start-window binding tuple begins all-NULL; partial population is rejected by the named binding_start_window_shape CHECK without changing the tuple, while the valid operation atomically records the complete tuple. A new pending job with a changed READY workspace generation is quarantined with WORKSPACE_IDENTITY_CONFLICT and retains DRAFT0, accepted command and zero receipts; an existing exact applied receipt remains replayable after the same identity change. The returned binding hash equals the digest of the independently constructed 18-field canonical document. While active, list/detail show the create command profile version and QUEUED1 state exactly once; command GET shows applied1 and POST same key/body returns the original accepted receipt. Once membership is revoked, external detail/command GET and POST replay are forbidden while only the internal machine-scoped receipt replay remains allowed.
new_case_groups.expected: Accepted, dispatched and applied remain separate states; no implicit later workflow step or human result is produced.
evidence: Before/after workspace token/generation and job/binding/receipt projection for both the pending-conflict and committed-replay paths.
Independent 18-field binding canonical bytes/hash and actual HTTP list/detail/command/POST outcomes before and after revocation.
new_case_groups.failure_recovery: Preserve isolated PG rows and sanitized private test output; rerun affected G4 and H2 SQL case after approved repair.
